page_title: ATA 4-0 PAR | Atalanta v Parma 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Juan Luca Sacchi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' 4 - 0 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 4:0.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
87' Fouls committed – 12:8.
85' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) brought his opponent down. Parma are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
85' It will be a substitution. Christian Ordonez (Parma) is ready to enter the pitch as Mandela Keita walks off.
83' The resulting corner from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
81' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
80' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Substitution. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) in, Marten de Roon out.

76' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it's not accurate and goes narrowly over the bar.
76' It seemed like Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
75' Mariano Troilo (Parma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Nikola Krstovic laid the ball off to Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
72' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replaces Charles De Ketelaere.
72' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
70' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) takes a good first touch from the pass, but mishits his shot low towards the middle of the goal and allows the Marco Carnesecchi to make a comfortable save.
69' Parma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' 14:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

65' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Edoardo Corvi shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) is coming onto the pitch as Oliver Sorensen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
60' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Nicola Zalewski is replaced by Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta).
60' Here comes a substitution. Gianluca Scamacca is given a rest as he is replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta).
59' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Isak Hien (Atalanta).
57' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) picks up a long through ball, but Marco Carnesecchi deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
55' The ball possession at the moment is 53:47.
53' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
51' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is cleared to safety by the defence.
49' Parma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
48' Marco Carnesecchi displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Emanuele Valeri (Parma) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
46' Half-time substitution. Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) will not participate anymore and Isak Hien is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is replaced by Gaetano Oristanio.
46' Carlos Cuesta has made a change at the break. Emanuele Valeri has come on in place of Alessandro Circati (Parma).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Carlos Cuesta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Adrian Benedyczak (Parma). He is replaced by Mateo Pellegrino.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Parma hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
41' The current number of corner kicks is 3:3.
39' Parma exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
37' Poor challenge! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is penalised for tripping and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle.
35' A player from Atalanta brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
33' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
31' Total attempts – 7:4.
29' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
28' Ederson (Atalanta) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
26' Looks like Ederson (Atalanta) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
24' 2 - 0 Marten de Roon (Atalanta) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top left corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
23' Parma keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
21' The corner is swung in but Parma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
20' The ratio of the ball possession is 55:45.
18' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is flagged for offside.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Edoardo Corvi into the bottom left corner.
15' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is going to take the penalty!
14' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Sascha Britschgi (Parma). Juan Luca Sacchi saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Atalanta.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.

12' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atalanta are going to take it.
11' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Parma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
8' Atalanta are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
6' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

6' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the left post, but Marco Carnesecchi pulls off a fine save to deny him. The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
5' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
3' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
2' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
1' The first half has just begun.
Atalanta will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
